text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Five opposition leaders were among the 18 people picked up by police after a riot staged by a coalition of opposition parties was quelled.
- The drug enforcement commission uncovered an illegal mandrax manufacturing factory in Lusaka and arrested two Tanzanians who were allegedly the kingpins of the operation.
- President Frederick Chiluba on Wednesday lashed out at opposition leaders for attempting to stage a mass demonstration against his government.
- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines and the Mineworkers' Union of Zambia are to continue negotiations on new salaries on Friday.
- The Ministry of Defence gave residents of 50 villages a seven-day ultimatum to move away from the areas they occupy.
